coverage_exempt.reason: Reached only when the slot count at [this+0xa4] is not positive; this xor leaves EDX zero and the original unconditionally reads [EDX+0x18] at 0x4d05da, a null access that faults before any recoverable return.

The only incoming edge at 0x4d0604 follows the same slot-range compare (0x4d05e6/0x4d05ea) that already selected a nonzero slot in range, with EDI, EDX and EAX unchanged and no call or write between; the out-of-range branch cannot be taken. It would also xor EAX and dereference [EAX+0x14], a null fault.

notes: Drafted by tools/claw/draft_spec.py from the disassembly. Platform code recovered because: 0x4f4a90 is the 8-byte element constructor that the Level 1 trace shows being called from the game's grid vector constructor (23616 calls); it is game object code in the MFC address range, and the owner queued it by address in level-one-batch-world-and-collision-03 Indirect receivers (settled 2026-10-20, level-one-indirect-receiver-repair): at all three sites in 0x4cda10 (0x4cdac9, 0x4cdb99, 0x4cdc5a) the original loads ECX = the tile handler (the word read from the handler table at [this+0x4c] indexed by the cell's low 16 bits) and calls the handler's virtual slot +0x20 as thiscall with two stack arguments (local x, local y), callee-pop. In the game that slot is 0x4cde10, which reads [ECX+0x14..0x20]. Native code must pass the handler as receiver; cases must supply the slot as a thiscall stub (or the original 0x4cde10) so that a receiver of 0 fails the comparison.
